title: EnrichedTestCase
description: STEP 2 (enrichTestCases) output. A tightened superset of test-case.schema.json that REQUIRES applicable_metrics to be filled in. STEP 1.5 (parseTestCases) may emit raw test cases without metrics; STEP 2 always runs to attach metric bindings, even for fully curated test cases.

applicable_metrics.description: Metric codes that MUST be evaluated against this test case. Each code MUST exist in the loaded MetricRegistry and MUST be compatible with this test case's role/scenarios.

weight_override.description: Optional per-test-case weight override. Aggregation defaults to the metric's own weight when absent.

source.description: STEP 2 always runs even if applicable_metrics already exists; this records that enforcement.

provenance.description: Same shape as test-case.schema.json#/properties/provenance. Synthesized cases MUST keep source='synthesized_from_user_scenarios' and remain outside the canonical catalog directory.

polarity.description: Case polarity for equivalence-class partitioning. positive = normal/allowed path; negative = restricted/escalation path; boundary = exactly at threshold. Used with paired_case_id to mark both sides of a decision boundary.

paired_case_id.description: test_case_id of the paired case on the opposite side of the same decision boundary. Positive points to negative and vice versa. Enables audit of boundary coverage completeness.
